_comment: Description transcribed verbatim from EA's Battlefield 6 maps page (https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/features/maps), read from the page's own __NEXT_DATA__ payload on 2026-08-02. Attributed to that page rather than to the game, because it was not read off an in-game screen. Maps carry no stat block or ratings.
name: Iberian Offensive

description.text: Sprint through Gibraltar’s winding streets, stalk its alleyways, dodge heavily-armored tanks, and tear through buildings–Iberian Offensive has many ways to secure a tactical advantage.
